description: Umbrella skill map for the Execution Operations skill tool: 20 categories and 200 catalogued capabilities, each routed to concrete operations of the tool. Used by the route and capabilities operations and by the contract planner.

skills.name: Ultimae Commander
skills.description: Act as the top-level command authority for complex execution plans. Select shells, establish working directories and environment state, sequence dependent commands, preserve successful outputs, and stop or recover safely when a command violates its expected contract.
skills.note: Top-level command authority: sequence dependent commands and stop safely when a contract is violated.

skills.name: Executor
skills.description: Turn an approved plan into concrete tool calls and commands. Track inputs, outputs, exit codes, side effects, artifacts, and completion checks so execution finishes with usable results rather than a partial run.

skills.name: Basher
skills.description: Author and run robust Bash workflows using strict mode, quoting, traps, functions, pipelines, process substitution, redirection, and portable fallbacks. Detect shell differences and avoid destructive wildcard or expansion errors.

skills.name: Runner
skills.description: Run scripts, binaries, tests, builds, and data jobs in the correct runtime. Resolve entry points, arguments, permissions, interpreters, dependencies, logs, and output locations before declaring success.

skills.name: Action
skills.description: Convert a natural-language objective into the smallest safe executable action, then validate the observed outcome. Prefer reversible steps, explicit scope, and direct completion criteria.

skills.name: Command Router
skills.description: Choose among CMD, PowerShell, Bash, Zsh, Python, Node.js, task runners, package scripts, containers, or native applications based on the operating system, task, and available interfaces.

skills.name: Shell Dialect Adapter
skills.description: Translate commands across Windows CMD, PowerShell, POSIX sh, Bash, and Zsh while preserving quoting, paths, environment variables, pipes, error behavior, and return-code semantics.

skills.name: Process Supervisor
skills.description: Start, monitor, pause, resume, terminate, and reap foreground or background processes. Capture process identifiers, detect orphaned work, and apply escalating shutdown from graceful stop to forced termination.

skills.name: Exit-Code Interpreter
skills.description: Map return codes, signals, stderr patterns, and partial output to actionable states such as success, retryable failure, configuration fault, dependency fault, permission fault, or user input error.

skills.name: Execution Contract Enforcer
skills.description: Require every command to define expected inputs, permitted side effects, success signals, failure signals, output paths, and cleanup behavior before it is used in a critical workflow.

skills.name: Adaptive Timeout Manager
skills.description: Set timeouts from workload type, input size, historical duration, and stage criticality. Extend only when progress signals remain healthy, and terminate stalled work with preserved diagnostics.

skills.name: Deadline Budgeter
skills.description: Allocate an overall time budget across setup, execution, verification, repair, export, and cleanup. Rebalance remaining time when a stage finishes early or consumes more than planned.

skills.name: Heartbeat Monitor
skills.description: Require periodic progress markers from long-running jobs. Distinguish slow progress from deadlock by monitoring timestamps, CPU, I/O, output growth, and child-process state.

skills.name: Checkpoint Resumer
skills.description: Add checkpoints to long jobs so interrupted work can resume from the last valid state instead of restarting. Verify checkpoint compatibility with code, inputs, and configuration.

skills.name: Scheduled Task Builder
skills.description: Create repeatable schedules using cron, systemd timers, Windows Task Scheduler, CI schedules, or queue triggers. Include timezone, missed-run, overlap, retry, and notification rules.

skills.name: Backoff Controller
skills.description: Apply bounded exponential backoff with jitter for transient failures. Respect service rate limits and stop retrying on deterministic faults or when the retry budget is exhausted.

skills.name: Long Job Detacher
skills.description: Run durable work with nohup, tmux, screen, systemd-run, job queues, or platform-native background services while preserving logs, environment state, and a reliable reconnection path.

skills.name: Stall Detector
skills.description: Detect jobs that are alive but not advancing through output stagnation, unchanged checkpoints, blocked system calls, queue inactivity, or resource starvation.

skills.name: Runtime Estimator
skills.description: Estimate duration from input volume, concurrency, throughput, warm-up, network latency, and verification cost. Update the estimate from observed progress without presenting guesses as guarantees.

skills.name: Graceful Cancellation
skills.description: Support cooperative cancellation tokens, signal handling, transaction rollback, temporary- file cleanup, and resumable state so interrupted work does not corrupt outputs.

skills.name: Parallel Command Composer
skills.description: Combine independent commands with safe parallel execution using xargs, GNU parallel, background jobs, PowerShell jobs, task pools, or workflow engines. Cap concurrency according to resources and service limits.

skills.name: Dependency Graph Orchestrator
skills.description: Represent tasks as a directed acyclic graph, execute ready nodes concurrently, block dependents on failure, and preserve per-node evidence and artifacts.

skills.name: Work Queue Manager
skills.description: Distribute units of work across workers with priorities, leases, visibility timeouts, acknowledgments, retries, dead-letter handling, and idempotent processing.

skills.name: Fan-Out Fan-In Coordinator
skills.description: Split a large input into bounded shards, process them in parallel, validate each shard, and merge results deterministically with duplicate and missing-part checks.

skills.name: Resource-Aware Scheduler
skills.description: Place work according to CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network, accelerator, and license constraints. Prevent oversubscription and leave headroom for operating-system stability.

skills.name: Concurrency Guard
skills.description: Prevent race conditions and duplicate work using locks, semaphores, atomic writes, compare-and-swap, unique job keys, and transactional boundaries.

skills.name: Pipeline Stage Manager
skills.description: Connect producer and consumer stages with explicit schemas, buffering, backpressure, ordering, and failure isolation. Verify every stage boundary.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Task Dispatcher
skills.description: Decompose an objective into specialist assignments with non-overlapping scope, shared assumptions, dependency order, and a final integrator responsible for consistency.

skills.name: Speculative Execution Controller
skills.description: Run alternative approaches only when the benefit exceeds cost. Select the first verified result, cancel redundant work, and retain diagnostics from losing paths when useful.

skills.name: Batch Window Optimizer
skills.description: Choose batch sizes and execution windows that balance throughput, memory, latency, API quotas, and recovery cost. Avoid producing batches too large to retry safely.

skills.name: Destructive Command Guard
skills.description: Identify deletes, overwrites, recursive operations, force flags, disk formatting, privilege changes, and production mutations. Require scope checks, backups, dry runs, or safer substitutes before execution.

skills.name: Least Privilege Operator
skills.description: Use the minimum permissions, credentials, roles, and filesystem access needed for each step. Drop elevated privilege immediately after the protected action.

skills.name: Dry-Run Planner
skills.description: Produce and execute a non-mutating preview when supported. Compare the predicted change set with the requested scope before allowing a write operation.

skills.name: Rollback Designer
skills.description: Pair every consequential change with a tested reversal, restore point, transaction, snapshot, version, or compensating action. State what cannot be rolled back.

skills.name: Secret Handling Sentinel
skills.description: Keep passwords, tokens, keys, cookies, connection strings, and private data out of commands, logs, prompts, process listings, repositories, and final artifacts.

skills.name: Permission Diagnostician
skills.description: Trace access failures through identity, ownership, ACLs, groups, capabilities, execution policy, sandboxing, mount options, and remote-service authorization.

skills.name: Change Approval Gate
skills.description: Classify changes by risk and require the appropriate evidence or approval before production, security, billing, identity, or data-retention actions.

skills.name: Scope Boundary Keeper
skills.description: Limit commands to explicitly targeted hosts, folders, accounts, subscriptions, projects, branches, and datasets. Reject ambiguous or unexpectedly broad matches.

skills.name: Environment Isolation Builder
skills.description: Create virtual environments, containers, sandboxes, temporary profiles, or disposable workspaces so experiments cannot contaminate the host or unrelated projects.

skills.name: Supply Chain Verifier
skills.description: Pin dependencies, validate checksums and signatures, inspect provenance, minimize install scripts, and flag abandoned, typosquatted, or unexpectedly privileged packages.

skills.name: Failure Triage Lead
skills.description: Classify a failure by layer: input, state, syntax, dependency, permissions, environment, network, logic, resource, export, or presentation. Probe the earliest bad state before changing anything.

skills.name: Retry Policy Engineer
skills.description: Define which failures may be retried, maximum attempts, backoff, idempotency requirements, and stop conditions. Never repeat an unchanged deterministic failure.

skills.name: Circuit Breaker Manager
skills.description: Open, probe, and close circuit breakers around unstable services to prevent cascading failures. Preserve fallback behavior and recovery telemetry.

skills.name: Partial Result Salvager
skills.description: Recover valid outputs from interrupted or partially failed runs. Mark completeness, rebuild only missing units, and prevent partial data from being mistaken for final data.

skills.name: Idempotency Designer
skills.description: Make repeated executions safe through stable keys, upserts, atomic swaps, deduplication, state checks, and replay-aware side effects.

skills.name: State Repair Technician
skills.description: Detect and repair corrupt caches, lock files, indexes, generated artifacts, migrations, and temporary state without discarding healthy work.

skills.name: Fallback Path Selector
skills.description: Switch to a simpler or alternate toolchain when the preferred path is unavailable, while preserving required fidelity and clearly documenting reduced capabilities.

skills.name: Chaos Scenario Tester
skills.description: Inject controlled process kills, latency, unavailable dependencies, low disk, malformed inputs, and interrupted networks to verify recovery behavior in a safe environment.

skills.name: Clean-State Reproducer
skills.description: Recreate failures in a disposable environment with fixed inputs, versions, locale, timezone, and configuration so the defect is repeatable and repairable.

skills.name: Incident Runbook Executor
skills.description: Follow a staged incident workflow for containment, diagnosis, recovery, validation, stakeholder update, and post-incident actions without improvising dangerous changes.

skills.name: Structured Log Architect
skills.description: Emit timestamped, leveled, machine-readable logs with job, stage, host, correlation, and error identifiers while redacting sensitive values.

skills.name: Command Trace Recorder
skills.description: Record commands, resolved arguments, working directory, relevant environment, duration, exit code, and artifact paths in a reproducible execution trace.

skills.name: Metric Instrumenter
skills.description: Measure throughput, latency, error rate, queue depth, resource use, retries, and completion quality. Choose counters, gauges, histograms, and service-level indicators appropriately.

skills.name: Distributed Trace Correlator
skills.description: Propagate trace and correlation identifiers across processes, services, queues, and agents so a failure can be followed end to end.

skills.name: Log Noise Reducer
skills.description: Separate signal from repetitive output using sampling, aggregation, rate controls, deduplication, and focused excerpts while preserving the original log for audit.

skills.name: Diagnostic Bundle Collector
skills.description: Gather versions, configurations, logs, process state, resource snapshots, network checks, and minimal reproduction inputs into a privacy-scrubbed support bundle.

skills.name: Performance Profiler
skills.description: Use CPU, memory, I/O, allocation, query, and flame profiling to identify measured bottlenecks before optimization.

skills.name: Health Check Designer
skills.description: Create shallow liveness checks and deeper readiness or dependency checks with bounded execution time and actionable failure detail.

skills.name: Anomaly Detector
skills.description: Flag meaningful deviations in duration, volume, resource use, error shape, or output quality relative to baselines without treating every fluctuation as an incident.

skills.name: Audit Trail Custodian
skills.description: Maintain tamper-evident records of who initiated an action, what changed, which version ran, what evidence passed, and how rollback was handled.

skills.name: Environment Bootstrapper
skills.description: Inspect the host and create the minimum reproducible runtime, directories, configuration, and dependencies needed for the task.

skills.name: Dependency Resolver
skills.description: Resolve version constraints, lock files, native libraries, peer dependencies, and platform compatibility. Prefer pinned, reproducible installs over floating latest versions.

skills.name: Runtime Version Manager
skills.description: Select and verify Python, Node.js, Java, .NET, Ruby, Go, Rust, shell, or other runtime versions using project files and supported toolchains.

skills.name: Virtual Environment Curator
skills.description: Create isolated Python, Conda, Node, or language-specific environments; activate them correctly; and export a reproducible dependency definition.

skills.name: Container Workspace Builder
skills.description: Create minimal container images, non-root users, deterministic layers, health checks, volumes, and entrypoints with a small attack surface.

skills.name: Cross-Platform Path Handler
skills.description: Normalize Windows, WSL, Linux, macOS, UNC, URL, and container paths without breaking separators, quoting, case sensitivity, or drive mappings.

skills.name: Environment Variable Steward
skills.description: Define, validate, inherit, override, and redact environment variables. Distinguish build- time, runtime, secret, and optional configuration.

skills.name: Toolchain Compatibility Checker
skills.description: Verify compilers, SDKs, CLIs, drivers, architecture, libc, GPU stack, and project formats before running expensive builds.

skills.name: Offline Execution Preparer
skills.description: Cache packages, models, documentation, and build inputs for disconnected operation while verifying licenses, integrity, and completeness.

skills.name: Reproducible Build Custodian
skills.description: Pin inputs, normalize timestamps, control locale and timezone, document tool versions, and compare outputs to reduce unexplained build drift.

skills.name: Repository Architect
skills.description: Organize source, tests, configuration, documentation, generated files, and deployment assets around clear module and ownership boundaries.

skills.name: Implementation Engineer
skills.description: Translate requirements into maintainable code with explicit interfaces, error handling, type boundaries, tests, and concise documentation.

skills.name: Codebase Navigator
skills.description: Map entry points, modules, dependencies, data flow, configuration, tests, and build commands before making changes to an unfamiliar repository.

skills.name: Refactoring Specialist
skills.description: Improve structure without changing intended behavior. Protect changes with characterization tests and perform small, reviewable transformations.

skills.name: API Contract Designer
skills.description: Define request, response, error, pagination, authentication, versioning, idempotency, and compatibility rules for HTTP, RPC, event, or library interfaces.

skills.name: Algorithm Selector
skills.description: Choose algorithms and data structures based on correctness, input scale, complexity, memory, stability, and implementation risk rather than novelty.

skills.name: Type Safety Enforcer
skills.description: Strengthen schemas, null handling, validation, generics, discriminated unions, and boundary types to prevent ambiguous runtime states.

skills.name: Error Handling Engineer
skills.description: Create actionable errors with stable categories, preserved causes, safe context, retry guidance, and user-appropriate messages.

skills.name: Configuration System Builder
skills.description: Design layered configuration with defaults, files, environment overrides, validation, secrets separation, and clear precedence.

skills.name: Dependency Boundary Refiner
skills.description: Reduce coupling through stable interfaces, adapters, dependency injection, module boundaries, and ownership of side effects.

skills.name: Test Strategy Designer
skills.description: Select unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, security, and acceptance tests according to risk and failure cost.

skills.name: Unit Test Author
skills.description: Write focused deterministic tests for logic, boundaries, error paths, and invariants using clear fixtures and minimal mocking.

skills.name: Integration Test Builder
skills.description: Verify real joins among databases, files, services, queues, runtimes, and third-party interfaces in controlled environments.

skills.name: End-to-End Journey Tester
skills.description: Exercise the recipient's actual workflow from clean start to final artifact, including setup, execution, export, reopening, and repeat use.

skills.name: Regression Gatekeeper
skills.description: Protect previously passing behavior with targeted tests, snapshots, baselines, and compatibility checks after repairs or enhancements.

skills.name: Property-Based Tester
skills.description: Generate broad input classes and verify invariants, shrinking failures to minimal counterexamples for parsers, transforms, and algorithms.

skills.name: Fuzzing Operator
skills.description: Feed malformed, unexpected, oversized, or adversarial inputs into parsers and interfaces under resource limits to discover crashes and unsafe assumptions.

skills.name: Golden Artifact Comparator
skills.description: Compare produced files, images, schemas, or reports against approved baselines with controlled tolerances and explainable diffs.

skills.name: Coverage Gap Analyst
skills.description: Evaluate whether critical branches, risk areas, and integration points are tested rather than optimizing only for a coverage percentage.

skills.name: Release Acceptance Judge
skills.description: Block delivery unless requirements, structure, semantics, boundaries, joins, regression, presentation, accessibility, performance, and handoff checks pass.

skills.name: Minimal Reproducer Builder
skills.description: Reduce a defect to the smallest input, code path, environment, and command that still fails, while preserving the original failure signal.

skills.name: Binary Search Debugger
skills.description: Narrow regressions across commits, inputs, stages, configurations, or data ranges using systematic halving and recorded observations.

skills.name: Hypothesis Probe Designer
skills.description: Create small experiments that distinguish competing causes. Change one relevant factor and define expected results before running the probe.

skills.name: Stack Trace Interpreter
skills.description: Trace exceptions through frames, async boundaries, generated code, wrappers, and root causes; distinguish the triggering site from the responsible defect.

skills.name: Memory Leak Investigator
skills.description: Use heap snapshots, allocation profiles, object retention paths, handles, and long-run measurements to isolate unbounded growth.

skills.name: Deadlock and Race Investigator
skills.description: Analyze thread dumps, lock order, shared state, event loops, timing, and synchronization to reproduce and repair concurrency defects.

skills.name: Network Failure Diagnostician
skills.description: Separate DNS, routing, proxy, TLS, firewall, authentication, protocol, rate-limit, and application failures with layered tests.

skills.name: Data Corruption Investigator
skills.description: Trace incorrect data to its earliest transformation, schema mismatch, encoding issue, race, truncation, or partial write and repair the responsible boundary.

skills.name: Build Failure Diagnostician
skills.description: Inspect compiler output, generated files, dependency graphs, caches, tool versions, linker state, and platform assumptions to repair builds precisely.

skills.name: Environment Drift Detector
skills.description: Compare working and failing environments across versions, variables, files, permissions, locale, timezone, architecture, and external services.

skills.name: Data Ingestion Operator
skills.description: Load files, APIs, streams, queues, and databases with schema validation, provenance, checkpoints, and duplicate control.

skills.name: Schema Mapper
skills.description: Map fields, types, units, null semantics, identifiers, and nested structures between source and target systems with explicit loss handling.

skills.name: Data Cleaner
skills.description: Normalize formats, encodings, whitespace, dates, categories, and missing values while preserving raw data and recording transformations.

skills.name: ETL Pipeline Builder
skills.description: Create extract, transform, and load stages with bounded batches, observability, restartability, data contracts, and reconciliation.

skills.name: Large File Processor
skills.description: Process CSV, JSONL, XML, Parquet, logs, archives, and binary formats with streaming or chunking to avoid memory exhaustion.

skills.name: Data Quality Auditor
skills.description: Check completeness, uniqueness, validity, consistency, referential integrity, timeliness, distributions, and business rules.

skills.name: Deduplication Specialist
skills.description: Detect exact and fuzzy duplicates using stable keys, normalization, blocking, similarity thresholds, and survivorship rules.

skills.name: Encoding and Locale Resolver
skills.description: Detect and normalize character encodings, delimiters, decimal symbols, date formats, Unicode normalization, and line endings.

skills.name: Archive and Compression Handler
skills.description: Create, inspect, extract, verify, and stream ZIP, TAR, GZIP, 7z, and related formats while preventing path traversal and decompression bombs.

skills.name: Data Reconciliation Analyst
skills.description: Compare source and target counts, totals, hashes, keys, and exceptions to prove that a migration or transformation is complete.

skills.name: SQL Query Engineer
skills.description: Write correct parameterized SQL with clear joins, grouping, window functions, pagination, and explain-plan awareness.

skills.name: Database Migration Manager
skills.description: Design forward and rollback migrations, data backfills, compatibility windows, locks, and deployment ordering for live systems.

skills.name: Transaction Boundary Designer
skills.description: Choose isolation levels, atomic units, retries, and consistency guarantees that match business invariants and contention.

skills.name: Query Performance Tuner
skills.description: Use execution plans, indexes, statistics, cardinality, partitioning, caching, and query rewrites to address measured bottlenecks.

skills.name: Backup and Restore Verifier
skills.description: Create backup policies and regularly prove restorability, retention, encryption, point-in- time recovery, and dependency completeness.

skills.name: Object Storage Operator
skills.description: Manage buckets, keys, multipart uploads, checksums, lifecycle rules, versioning, access policies, and large-object transfer.

skills.name: Cache Strategy Engineer
skills.description: Define cache keys, lifetimes, invalidation, stampede prevention, consistency, warming, and fallback behavior.

skills.name: Search Index Builder
skills.description: Create analyzers, mappings, ingestion, ranking signals, filters, synonyms, and reindex workflows for full-text or vector search.

skills.name: Vector Retrieval Engineer
skills.description: Design chunking, embeddings, metadata filters, hybrid retrieval, reranking, evaluation sets, and citation boundaries for retrieval systems.

skills.name: Storage Capacity Planner
skills.description: Forecast growth, retention, replication, backup, index overhead, throughput, and cost while defining warning and hard-stop thresholds.

skills.name: HTTP Workflow Operator
skills.description: Construct and validate HTTP requests, headers, cookies, authentication, redirects, compression, timeouts, retries, and response handling.

skills.name: API Integration Builder
skills.description: Integrate third-party APIs with schema validation, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, versioning, and resilient error mapping.

skills.name: Webhook Receiver Engineer
skills.description: Validate signatures, timestamps, replay protection, event ordering, retries, deduplication, and asynchronous processing.

skills.name: Web Application Builder
skills.description: Create accessible responsive interfaces with clear state, secure input handling, resilient data loading, and production-ready build paths.

skills.name: Browser Automation Operator
skills.description: Automate user journeys with stable selectors, waits, downloads, uploads, authentication state, screenshots, and failure artifacts.

skills.name: DNS and TLS Operator
skills.description: Diagnose records, propagation, resolvers, certificates, trust chains, hostname validation, protocol versions, and renewal automation.

skills.name: Reverse Proxy Configurator
skills.description: Configure routing, headers, TLS termination, compression, buffering, health checks, limits, and upstream failover for common proxies.

skills.name: Rate Limit Coordinator
skills.description: Respect upstream quotas and protect downstream systems with token bucket, leaky bucket, concurrency caps, and client-visible retry guidance.

skills.name: Network Capture Analyst
skills.description: Use connection tests, packet captures, timing, and protocol inspection to localize network failures without collecting unnecessary sensitive payloads.

skills.name: Contract Compatibility Monitor
skills.description: Detect breaking changes in OpenAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, event schemas, or SDK interfaces before deployment.

skills.name: Git Workflow Operator
skills.description: Inspect status and history, create focused branches and commits, resolve conflicts, and avoid losing uncommitted work.

skills.name: Patch Curator
skills.description: Produce minimal reviewable diffs that change only the responsible code and include tests and migration notes where required.

skills.name: Merge Conflict Resolver
skills.description: Understand both sides, preserve intent, resolve semantic conflicts, rerun impacted checks, and avoid mechanical acceptance of either version.

skills.name: Build Pipeline Engineer
skills.description: Create deterministic compile, bundle, package, test, and artifact stages with cache correctness and clear failure boundaries.

skills.name: CI Workflow Designer
skills.description: Configure triggers, matrices, secrets, permissions, caching, concurrency, artifacts, approvals, and required checks in continuous integration.

skills.name: Release Packager
skills.description: Version, sign, checksum, archive, and document release artifacts with reproducible names and complete installation or upgrade instructions.

skills.name: Deployment Orchestrator
skills.description: Coordinate environment checks, rollout order, migrations, health validation, traffic shift, rollback, and post-deployment observation.

skills.name: Blue-Green Release Manager
skills.description: Maintain two production-ready environments, validate the inactive side, shift traffic safely, and preserve rapid rollback.

skills.name: Canary Controller
skills.description: Release to a bounded audience or traffic percentage, compare health and quality metrics, and expand or abort using explicit thresholds.

skills.name: Artifact Provenance Keeper
skills.description: Link every artifact to source revision, build environment, dependency lock, signature, tests, and release decision.

skills.name: Infrastructure as Code Engineer
skills.description: Model networks, compute, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, and policy in reviewable declarative code with state protection.

skills.name: Cloud Resource Operator
skills.description: Create, inspect, resize, tag, stop, and remove cloud resources within explicit account, region, project, and cost boundaries.

skills.name: Kubernetes Workload Operator
skills.description: Manage manifests, deployments, services, jobs, configuration, secrets, probes, resources, rollout status, logs, and safe rollback.

skills.name: Container Runtime Diagnostician
skills.description: Inspect images, layers, entrypoints, networking, mounts, permissions, architecture, resource limits, and runtime logs.

skills.name: Serverless Function Engineer
skills.description: Build event-driven functions with cold-start awareness, bounded execution, idempotency, retries, observability, and least privilege.

skills.name: Network Architecture Builder
skills.description: Design subnets, routing, gateways, firewalls, private endpoints, service discovery, and controlled ingress or egress.

skills.name: Identity and Access Engineer
skills.description: Define users, groups, roles, service identities, trust policies, short-lived credentials, and access reviews.

skills.name: Autoscaling Policy Designer
skills.description: Scale on measured demand using safe minimums, maximums, cooldowns, queue depth, utilization, and downstream capacity.

skills.name: Disaster Recovery Planner
skills.description: Define recovery time and recovery point objectives, replication, backups, dependency order, failover, and periodic recovery exercises.

skills.name: Cloud Cost Guard
skills.description: Estimate and monitor compute, storage, network, managed service, and licensing cost; detect idle or runaway resources before budget impact grows.

skills.name: Threat Modeler
skills.description: Identify assets, trust boundaries, actors, entry points, abuse cases, mitigations, residual risk, and verification tasks before implementation.

skills.name: Secure Code Reviewer
skills.description: Review authentication, authorization, input handling, output encoding, cryptography, secrets, file access, deserialization, and dependency use.

skills.name: Vulnerability Triage Analyst
skills.description: Validate findings, determine reachability and impact, prioritize remediation, identify compensating controls, and verify the fix.

skills.name: Static Analysis Operator
skills.description: Configure and interpret language and security analyzers, suppress only proven false positives, and convert findings into targeted repairs.

skills.name: Dynamic Security Tester
skills.description: Exercise a running application for authentication, session, injection, authorization, upload, request-forgery, and configuration weaknesses within authorized scope.

skills.name: Secret Scanner
skills.description: Detect credentials and sensitive values in source, history, artifacts, logs, and configuration, then support rotation and history cleanup.

skills.name: Software Bill of Materials Curator
skills.description: Inventory components, versions, licenses, hashes, and dependency relationships in standard machine-readable formats.

skills.name: Cryptography Usage Reviewer

skills.name: Security Hardening Operator

skills.name: Security Incident Containment

skills.name: Technical Documentation Writer

skills.name: Runbook Author

skills.name: Command Cookbook Curator

skills.name: Architecture Decision Recorder
skills.description: Document context, considered options, decision, trade-offs, consequences, and revisit triggers for significant technical choices.

skills.name: Change Summary Generator

skills.name: Troubleshooting Guide Builder
skills.description: Organize symptoms into layered diagnostics and smallest-first probes, with clear expected results and repairs.

skills.name: Artifact Handoff Editor
skills.description: Package files with names, paths, open or run instructions, prerequisites, editable sources, and a clean recipient workflow.

skills.name: Knowledge Base Maintainer
skills.description: Deduplicate, structure, cross-link, date, own, and retire instructions so operational knowledge remains discoverable and trustworthy.

skills.name: Diagram Specification Writer

skills.name: Executive Technical Summarizer
skills.description: Translate complex execution outcomes into decisions, risks, evidence, cost, timeline, and next actions without hiding material limitations.

skills.name: Intent Decomposer
skills.description: Convert a broad goal into observable outcomes, constraints, assumptions, dependencies, and completion checks without losing the user's actual objective.

skills.name: Plan Compiler
skills.description: Turn a task model into ordered executable steps with tools, inputs, outputs, decision gates, rollback points, and validation.

skills.name: Capability Router
skills.description: Select the smallest capable skill, tool, connector, or agent for each subtask based on fit, access, repeatability, and repair cost.

skills.name: Context Budget Manager
skills.description: Keep active context focused by summarizing stable facts, loading references only when needed, and separating working detail from final output.

skills.name: Assumption Ledger
skills.description: Record material assumptions, test those that can alter the result, and surface only unresolved assumptions that matter to the recipient.

skills.name: Constraint Resolver

skills.name: Evidence Integrator
skills.description: Combine tool outputs, test results, source facts, and observations while distinguishing verified facts, interpretations, and unknowns.

skills.name: Task State Custodian
skills.description: Track pending, running, blocked, failed, completed, and verified states with dependencies and artifacts so multi-step work does not drift.

skills.name: Agent Handoff Protocol
skills.description: Pass concise goals, scope, inputs, outputs, assumptions, open risks, and acceptance criteria between agents without leaking irrelevant context.

skills.name: Completion Judge
skills.description: Declare completion only when the requested form exists, direct requirements map to delivered parts, critical checks pass, and the handoff works from a clean state.

skills.name: Bottleneck Locator
skills.description: Measure before optimizing and identify whether time is spent in CPU, allocation, disk, network, database, contention, serialization, startup, or external waits.

skills.name: Benchmark Designer
skills.description: Create representative warm-up, steady-state, peak, and stress benchmarks with fixed inputs, controlled environments, and statistically useful repetitions.

skills.name: Load Test Operator
skills.description: Model realistic arrival rates, concurrency, user journeys, payloads, and think time; observe saturation and recovery without harming production.

skills.name: Memory Footprint Optimizer
skills.description: Reduce retained objects, copies, buffers, caches, and batch sizes while preserving correctness and avoiding excessive recomputation.

skills.name: I/O Throughput Engineer
skills.description: Improve read and write patterns through buffering, streaming, batching, asynchronous operations, locality, compression, and parallelism within device limits.

skills.name: Latency Budget Analyst
skills.description: Break end-to-end response time into stage budgets, identify tail latency, and prioritize changes that improve the user-visible critical path.

skills.name: Capacity Modeler
skills.description: Estimate safe throughput and concurrency from service time, resource limits, queue behavior, growth, redundancy, and failure headroom.

skills.name: Cache Performance Tuner
skills.description: Measure hit rate, miss cost, eviction, key cardinality, TTL, consistency, and memory overhead before adjusting cache policy.

skills.name: Compiler and Build Optimizer
skills.description: Improve incremental builds, dependency graphs, caching, parallelism, generated code, linking, and artifact reuse without weakening reproducibility.

skills.name: Cost Performance Optimizer
skills.description: Compare performance gain against infrastructure, licensing, complexity, and operational cost and prefer the best verified total value.

skills.name: CLI Designer

skills.name: Task Runner Builder

skills.name: Script Library Curator

skills.name: Interactive Prompt Automator

skills.name: File Watcher Operator

skills.name: Clipboard and Pipe Integrator

skills.name: Installer and Uninstaller Engineer

Use environment variables, secret stores, or connected credentials with least privilege.  Require explicit safeguards for destructive commands, privilege escalation, production changes, billing impact, and broad data access.  Preserve logs, diagnostics, and valid partial artifacts when a run fails, but remove temporary or sensitive residue from delivery packages.  Provide a clean handoff: exact files, paths, open or run instructions, prerequisites, and known limitations.
